repository_commit_note: The commit that adds this kernel; this provenance record sits on top of it, so the branch head that ships it has a later hash.
scope: Ascend 950DT GemmINT8W8A8FwdOp: all 29 manifest workload cases (Llama-3 8B/70B and Qwen2.5-7B/72B under SmoothQuant, batch 1 to 4096 rows, per-token/per-tensor activation and per-channel/per-tensor weight scales, one biased QKV projection, and the float16 output variant). Not a public performance receipt.

campaign.metric: arithmetic mean of raw ffts device execution interval unions
campaign.reason: Task-private protocol adapter: one profiler window carries all 25 calls instead of one window per call. The eviction and the parsed statistic are unchanged; the public default-clock receipt and the host-wide reservation are still unavailable.
campaign.workspace: Task acceptance workspace, kept outside the repository.
campaign.stage_protocol: Each pass is timed with the same window; `forward` is the sum of the two passes, so the stages account for the end-to-end cost.

baseline.reference: This backend's INT8 product on the same shape, same round: identical Cube work, so the ratio isolates the epilogue.
baseline.vendor_ops: No like-for-like baseline in this container. torch_npu's npu_weight_quant_batchmatmul serves A16W4/A16W8 (BF16 or FP16 activations), and no ACLNN entry point takes INT8 activations with these scale granularities.

replay.result: 29 of 29 manifest cases verified, status passed, source fingerprint unchanged
replay.guard: scripts/npu_guard.py with /dev/davinci0 remapped to /dev/davinci1 for this site
replay.receipt: Task acceptance workspace, kept outside the repository.

verification.tolerances: The shared workload numeric policy through the public runner: exact on both sides, one output ulp allowed (2^-7 in bfloat16, 2^-10 in float16).
